summary: The exact candidate adds root-only tensor-parallel logits gather for compatible eager generation and broadcasts sampled token IDs to every TP rank. It retains all-gather for paths that consume logits on every rank or cannot safely capture gather, including dLLM, speculative decoding, logprob/prefill-only work, decode CUDA graphs, attention/DP variants, and TP LM-head all-to-all. Independent tests reproduced the base's unconditional all-gather behavior and verified both prior review counterexamples are corrected. This is a source feature fix with regression hardening, not merely a test-only change.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: 3 failures. The base has no gather-selection policy or gather marker and unconditionally calls _logits_gatherer for ordinary TP logits. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-eb55a24e73c6/base-independent.log

15 tests passed. Independently checked eager gather selection, every encoded all-rank exclusion, graph-capture exclusion, root sampling plus broadcast, non-root no-sampling behavior, grammar-mask release, stale auxiliary-output clearing, and adjacent decode-row behavior. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-eb55a24e73c6/candidate-focused.log

Actual two-process CPU/Gloo collective semantics: only rank 0 received concatenated vocabulary shards, rank 0 selected token 3, and both ranks received token 3 by broadcast. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-eb55a24e73c6/gloo-collective.log

On one AMD Instinct MI350X, an independent FP32 full-vocabulary projection exactly matched two vocabulary shards concatenated in TP order: max_abs_error=0.0 and identical argmax tokens. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-eb55a24e73c6/gpu-numerical.log

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible and used with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 for the numerical reference. Imported SGLang source paths resolved to /job/repo; see /job/review-evidence-j-eb55a24e73c6/candidate-import-paths.log.
remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so a real two-rank RCCL gather/broadcast model or serving run and a collective performance comparison could not be performed.
The CPU/Gloo collective test validates root-only gather and token-broadcast semantics but does not substitute for RCCL backend validation.
The one-GPU numerical test validates vocabulary shard ordering and token equivalence, not distributed transport.

CUDA graph, speculative decoding, return-logprob, prefill-only, DP-attention, attention-TP, TP-LM-head all-to-all, and dLLM paths intentionally retain all-gather; the original request is satisfied by adding gather under safe supported conditions, not by replacing every all-gather.
No C/C++/CUDA/HIP/native source changed in the candidate, and repository-environment.json provides no native artifact, so no native rebuild was applicable.
No model weights were used. The provided tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify a multi-GPU distributed workload or dLLM and was therefore not used as substitute proof.
